S1.title: Agriculture in Tajikistan (Wikipedia)
S1.note: Лалмӣ/obi: cotton in hot river valleys (Ferghana/Sughd, Vakhsh & Lower Kofarnihon, Kyzylsu & Panj, Gissar); potatoes, vegetables, melons across the country; uplands = potato, wheat, horticulture; 2018 output list (potato, onion, watermelon, tomato, carrot, cucumber, cabbage, maize); Istaravshan ~30,000 ha irrigated only 55% water demand met; Kulob Kyzyl-Su–Yah-Su 60,000 ha 65%.

S2.note: 19,500 t raw cotton in 2007 (16% of Sughd cotton).
